I'm currently a university student in the UK, recently I had to evacuate my residence due to a fire, as a result of doing as I had been told and not stopping to grab anything I ended up spending a miserable day on the pavement, with no ID, Water, Jacket or cash.

It occurred to me while I was freezing my arse off on the pavement that my situation could have been much less unpleasant had I been better prepared, and could have potentially been much much worse and if it had been so, I would have been entirely unprepared.

So I decided that I should pack a bag with some essentials and keep it by the the door just in case I ever found myself in the same situation, if the same thing occurred today I would at least have a warm jacket, phone numbers and cash. Following on from this I realised that there could be much worse emergencies than a fire, including potential terrorist attacks. I am looking for advice and feedback as to what I should include in my emergency bag, I live in a city centre and have family who live in the country side.

This is what I am considering for my bag at the moment.

  • One of those cheap and seemingly indestructible mobiles "burner phone".

  • A warm jacket.

  • Cash in a waterproof container.

  • Water and some food.

  • Multi-tool, I was thinking from Leatherman.

  • First aid kit.

  • Dust Masks.

  • Emergency Blanket.

  • Waterproof pad, pen/pencil and permanent marker.

  • City Map, national road and railway maps.

  • ID Info, passport/driver licence numbers etc.

  • Head torch and spare batteries.

  • Some sort of tool for self defence.

And of course a bag to put it all in, any recommendations for contents or particular products and any advice in general would be greatly appreciated.
